queries_run: Tesla China export control rare earth 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 2025 年美國關稅調升及報復措施已影響供應鏈成本，並可能影響部分技術或零組件的取得（視關稅範圍與報復性出口管制而定）。
findings.excerpt: U.S. trade policy alterations in 2025, including heightened import tariffs and subsequent retaliatory measures, have impacted our supply chain costs, and may impact the availability of certain technologies or components, depending on the exact scope of the tariffs ultimately implemented and retaliatory export controls.

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A 稱現行關稅制度對儲能業務的衝擊相對大於汽車業務；進口關稅可能顯著推高電池電芯成本。
findings.excerpt: The current tariff regime will have a relatively larger impact on our energy generation and storage business compared to our automotive business.

findings.claim: 2025 年汽車銷售成本下降，部分被關稅增加抵銷。
findings.excerpt: partially offset by lower fixed cost absorption and an increase in tariffs compared to the prior year.

findings.claim: 公司在中國與德國設廠，以降低運輸與製造成本並限制不利關稅的影響。
findings.excerpt: Internationally, we also have manufacturing facilities in China and Germany, which allows us to increase the affordability of our vehicles for customers in local markets by reducing transportation and manufacturing costs and limiting the impact of unfavorable tariffs.

reg_tariff_export.note: 出口管制面：搜尋僅見 2025 年稀土磁鐵限制影響 Optimus（bgov、Fortune），2026 年 Tesla 專屬進展查無來源；Section 232 汽車關稅搜尋僅得第三方彙整，未取得 Tesla 專屬 2026 資料。
